note: Validation must recompute the fingerprint from the loaded contract and verify it matches this exact value before trusting any other output.
day_dependence_emphasis: The candidate's main unresolved Task71 weakness is DAY dependence (day-clustered CI crosses zero at every Task71 cell). This protocol therefore explicitly weighs distinct-day breadth and day-cluster bootstrap evidence, not just trade count.
VALIDATION_PASS_requires_all_of: 3. net_expectancy_15bps >= 0 OR clearly economically non-trivial positive performance at 10bps with a documented reason why 15bps is slightly below zero
8. removing the top 3 winning trades does not flip the strategy into a materially large negative expectancy

9. performance is not carried exclusively by one small time subsegment (early/mid/late thirds -- at least two of three segments must show the same sign as the overall result, or the exception must be explained by data-quality/day-count asymmetry, not cherry-picked)

10. day-cluster bootstrap is not strongly contradictory to the positive point estimate -- the day-cluster CI does NOT have to exclude zero by itself, but if the point estimate is weak AND the day-cluster distribution is clearly negative (ci_high < 0), that combination is FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE as appropriate
11. symbol-cluster result must not materially contradict the edge (symbol-cluster CI should not be clearly negative, i.e. ci_high < 0)
12. stop behavior is operationally reasonable: no obvious execution/coding pathology (e.g. stop_rate not implausibly 0% or 100%, no fingerprint/causality violation in the stop logic)
13. no causal/data-quality/fingerprint violation (fingerprint match, zero interpolated/forward-filled/synthetic prices, all timestamps causal)
14. long-only mechanism remains directionally consistent with Task71 (gross_expectancy_pct > 0, matching Task71's LONG-side finding)
15. costs do not erase essentially all economic edge (net_expectancy_10bps_pct remains a non-trivial positive fraction of gross_expectancy_pct, not reduced to near-zero)

classifications.VALIDATION_PASS: All 15 criteria above are collectively satisfied.
classifications.VALIDATION_FAIL: Material contradiction of the frozen hypothesis -- e.g. net_expectancy_primary_cost is negative AND gross direction is also inconsistent with the LONG residual-momentum hypothesis (not merely thin/inconclusive), OR a clear causal/data-integrity/fingerprint violation is found.
classifications.VALIDATION_INCONCLUSIVE: Sample/data uncertainty prevents a trustworthy decision either way -- e.g. session_coverage or symbol_coverage fall short of criteria 4/5, or the day-cluster/symbol-cluster evidence is too wide/ambiguous to support either PASS or FAIL confidently. This is NOT the same as FAIL.

explicit_prohibitions: Do not loosen, reweight, or drop any of the 15 criteria after seeing the actual validation numbers.
Do not rerun Task71's 72-cell discovery grid.
Do not tune threshold/horizon/stop using validation-holdout outcomes.
Replication is FORBIDDEN unless classification is exactly VALIDATION_PASS -- FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE must not be followed by a replication attempt on a different window.
